title: Profile Update: The Effects of Identity Disclosure on Network Connections and Language
measurement_description: The paper measures behavioral changes following the explicit disclosure of social identities (including religion) on Twitter profiles. Specifically, it evaluates whether adding a religious identity leads to an increase in identity-aligned language in tweets, changes in network connections (bonding with same-identity users), and whether it attracts targeted offensive replies from others.
findings: Users who add a religious identity (such as Islam, Hinduism, Christianity, or Atheism) to their Twitter profile generate more tweets containing language that aligns with their identity. Additionally, contrary to concerns about marginalized groups facing more hostility upon disclosure, disclosing religious identities through both profile updates and tweet language actually led to reduced levels of offensive replies from others.
